title: Same-Day Bill Cancellation (Alt + C) & Audit Reversals

intro.title: Same-Day Bill Cancellation
intro.subtitle: Manager authorization, exact batch inventory restoration, reversing journals, and audit preservation

narration.text: Welcome to Phase 2, Part 15: Same-Day Bill Cancellation. When a patient changes their mind or an accidental entry error occurs, authorized managers can cancel the transaction with full audit integrity.
Open the invoice from Sales and Invoices or press Alt plus M. Press Alt plus C or click Cancel Bill to open the secure cancellation dialog.
Under statutory GST rules, cancellations are strictly permitted on the same business day before midnight IST. Enter a mandatory audit reason to proceed.
MediFlow automatically restores medicine quantities back into their exact batches, posts a balanced reversing double-entry journal, and voids the outward invoice in GSTR-1.
Schedule H, H1, and X dispensing logs remain permanently preserved with indelible audit timestamps. In Part 16, we process Customer Sale Returns and GST Credit Notes!

outro.takeaway: Same-Day Cancellation: Restore batch inventory, reverse financial journals, and preserve statutory drug dispensing logs with full manager audit trails.
